race.title: Join Racing TV Now With A Free Trial Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: French bumper winner MAESTRO DES PINS showed ability on his debut here for Willie Mullins back in May and he makes most appeal ahead of Darby O'Gill , who was an expensive purchase from France for the Gordon Elliott yard after making the frame on 2 of his 3 starts for former connections. Henry de Bromhead's point winner Personal Space also merits consideration on Rules debut. MAESTRO DES PINS (FR) DARBY O'GILL (IRE) PERSONAL SPACE (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Maestro Des Pins (9/4), Darby O'gill (7/2), Personal Space (5/1), Rickety Kate (8/1), Bergomi (8/1), Hard Ball (10/1), Dark Summit (12/1), Old Score (12/1), Loadstone (14/1), Poledriver (16/1), Puck Out (16/1), Flooring Brandy (16/1), Unfold (25/1), Clean As A Whistle (25/1), Michael Frances (33/1), A Poets Day Out (50/1), Miss Stargazer (66/1), Good Vibrations (66/1)
